about_the_game:
Raise, multiply, and battle with dice — a dice deck-building roguelike!

Utilize a unique system where all dice on the field roll simultaneously and their outcomes collide to shape the fight.
In both battles and events, everything is up to the roll. Embark on a journey where luck meets strategy!

Key Features

◆ Simultaneous Roll System
Choose whether to convert hand dice into mana or play them onto the field. All dice—including ally, enemy, and weather dice—are rolled at once and calculated together. Their combined results determine the flow of battle.

◆ Dice Customization
Dice can receive temporary boosts in combat through the effects of relics and skills. Outside of combat, you can permanently enhance them through events such as duplication and fusion, or by applying special enchantments.

◆ Strategic Variety
The combination of characters, dice, enchantments, relics, skills, and enemies—along with your choices—will lead your adventure down unexpected paths.
